schema.text: On your usual trip, how do empty or deserted streets make you feel, especially in the evening?

options.text: I don't come across such streets on my usual trip

en.#On your usual trip, how do empty or des: On your usual trip, how do empty or deserted streets make you feel, especially in the evening?
en.#I don't come across such streets on my: I don't come across such streets on my usual trip

it.#On your usual trip, how do empty or des: Durante il tuo spostamento abituale, come ti fanno sentire le strade vuote o deserte, soprattutto di sera?
it.#Neither comfortable nor uncomfortable: Né a mio agio né a disagio
it.#I don't come across such streets on my: Non incontro strade così nel mio spostamento abituale

fr.#On your usual trip, how do empty or des: Lors de votre trajet habituel, comment vous sentez-vous dans les rues vides ou désertes, surtout le soir ?
fr.#Neither comfortable nor uncomfortable: Ni à l’aise ni mal à l’aise
fr.#I don't come across such streets on my: Je ne rencontre pas ce type de rues lors de mon trajet habituel

de.#On your usual trip, how do empty or des: Wie fühlen Sie sich auf Ihrem üblichen Weg in leeren oder menschenleeren Straßen, vor allem abends?
de.#I don't come across such streets on my: Auf meinem üblichen Weg gibt es solche Straßen nicht

tr.#On your usual trip, how do empty or des: Olağan yolculuğunuzda boş veya ıssız sokaklar, özellikle akşamları, size nasıl hissettiriyor?

fa.#On your usual trip, how do empty or des: در سفر معمول خود، خیابان‌های خالی یا خلوت، به‌ویژه هنگام عصر و شب، چه احساسی به شما می‌دهند؟
fa.#I don't come across such streets on my: در سفر معمولم با چنین خیابان‌هایی روبه‌رو نمی‌شوم

hu.#On your usual trip, how do empty or des: Hogyan érzi magát a szokásos útja során az üres vagy kihalt utcákon, különösen este?
hu.#I don't come across such streets on my: A szokásos utam során nem találkozom ilyen utcákkal

ar.#On your usual trip, how do empty or des: في تنقّلك المعتاد، كيف تجعلك الشوارع الفارغة أو المهجورة تشعر، خاصة في المساء؟
ar.#I don't come across such streets on my: لا أصادف مثل هذه الشوارع في تنقّلي المعتاد
